text:
10. 1. 6

Piyaṅkarasuttaṃ. 

240. Ekaṃ samayaṃ āyasmā anuruddho sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme. Tena kho pana samayena āyasmā anuruddho rattiyā paccūsasamayaṃ paccuṭṭhāya dhammapadānī bhāsati. Atha kho piyaṅkaramātā yakkhinī puttakaṃ evaṃ tosesi: 

Mā saddaṃ kari piyaṅkara bhikkhu dhammapadāni bhāsati, 

Api ca dhammapadaṃ vijāniya paṭipajjema hitāya no siyā. 

Pāṇesu ca saṃyamāmase sampajānamusā na bhaṇāmase, 

Sikkhema susīlamattano api muccema pisācayoniyāti.
